subject: Verdant Systems - Launch & Handoff: MAP and Weekly Rituals
body:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdant.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@verdant.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — launch window and next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers and the routing options. We need to lock a go-live window for Q3 and confirm responsibilities for data onboarding and security signoffs.

High-level asks from Verdant:
- Target go-live: flexible between Aug 30 - Sep 15 (we prefer earlier)
- Data ingestion: CSV batch + incremental API (we own the extract, need your ingest spec)
- SOC2 evidence: security questionnaire incoming from procurement

Can you send a concise mutual action plan with milestones, owners, and dates so our project manager can orient internal stakeholders?

Best,
Elaine
VP, Platform Operations
Verdant Systems

--- Message 2 of 5 ---
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdant.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Verdant Systems - Launch & Handoff: MAP and Weekly Rituals

Hi Elaine (and Tom),

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-Verdant-v1.xlsx) and an implementation checklist PDF. High level follow-up below — I designed this to be lightweight for your PM to drop into a status cadence.

Quick summary (owners + target dates):
- Kickoff & discovery (data schema, access) — Marissa (Redwood); Target: 2027-07-21
- Security & SOC2 evidence packet — Karthik (Redwood Security); Target: 2027-07-25
- Ingest spec & sample transfer — Verdant team; Target: 2027-07-25
- Ingestion test (CSV batch + incremental API) — Ben (Redwood Eng) / Verdant data ops; Target: 2027-08-05
- Validation & sample traffic (QA) — Ben / Verdant QA; Target: 2027-08-15
- Performance tune & quantization profile selection — Redwood runtime team; Target: 2027-08-22
- Go/no-go review & signoff — Elaine (Verdant) + Marissa (Redwood); Target: 2027-08-26
- Planned go-live window — 2027-08-30 to 2027-09-02 (contingency through 2027-09-15)

Proposed cadence:
- Weekly 30-min standup (Wednesdays 10:00 PT) starting 2027-07-21
- Engineering deep-dive bi-weekly (if needed)

Action items for this week:
1) Verdant: share initial sample export and data dictionary by 2027-07-20
2) Redwood: provide ingest API spec and temporary S3 location by 2027-07-18 (attachment: implementation-checklist.pdf)
3) Karthik: SOC2 evidence owner + list of docs to expect by 2027-07-18

Attachments: MAP-Verdant-v1.xlsx (workbook with milestone rows + acceptance criteria), implementation-checklist.pdf, verdant-kickoff-slide-deck.pptx (short summary).

Open to tightening dates if your PM prefers a different cadence. If you confirm kickoff date (21st), I’ll send calendar invites and a shared Drive folder.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--- Message 3 of 5 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdant.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Systems - Launch & Handoff: MAP and Weekly Rituals

Thanks Marissa — flagged a few engineering considerations in the MAP (sheet: Runtime & Ingest Notes). Short highlights:
- We'll provision a dedicated ingest pipeline and a staging inference pool for Verdant's initial traffic profile (baseline: 4 RPS, 200 tokens avg).
- Need sample payloads (see MAP) and a list of error codes to mock for QA.
- ETA for initial test harness: 2027-07-28. Ben will own the harness creation; Verdant to provide sample data before 7/25.

I’ve attached a short stub of the expected payload and a sample log extract in the Drive folder. If Verdant plans heavy embedding use, we should discuss memory-reserved instances during the 8/22 perf tune.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

--- Message 4 of 5 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdant.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Systems - Launch & Handoff: MAP and Weekly Rituals

Adding security notes — tagging the SOC2 questionnaire thread (I’ll upload the evidence checklist to the shared Drive). Two clarifications for Verdant Procurement:
1) We can provide redacted audit logs and retention policies; need to agree on retention window (default 30 days, extendable).
2) For private key access, we support KMS integrations; if Verdant requires HSM, that will be a separate work item and schedule impact.

Karthik (Security)
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

--- Message 5 of 5 (final confirmation) ---
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdant.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@verdant.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Verdant Systems - Launch & Handoff: MAP and Weekly Rituals

Marissa — this is great, thanks. Verdant PM confirms kickoff on 2027-07-21 10:00 PT and weekly Wednesday standups at the same time. We’ve uploaded a small sample CSV and data dictionary to the Drive link you shared.

Two quick notes from our side:
- Procurement: expecting a short SOC2 questionnaire by end of day 7/20 — Tom will route to Karthik.
- Go-live preference: Verdant will aim for 2027-08-30 but will confirm after the first validation window.

I signed the initial mutual action plan and uploaded a signed acknowledgement to the Drive — link included in the HubSpot deal. We’ll also send a DocuSign envelope for the MSA addendum later this week.

Best,
Elaine
VP, Platform Operations
Verdant Systems

--- End of thread ---
